biggest_catch: The referrer's reward is only a £5 voucher per referral (the £10 goes to the friend), issued only after the friend places an order — and Oilfast can amend or disallow the scheme without notice, so the amounts can change at any time.
catches: The referrer earns a £5 voucher per successful referral; the £10 discount goes to the friend, not you.
Your £5 voucher is only credited after the referred friend places an order with Oilfast.
You must have the friend's permission before referring them.
Only one referral email per delivery address will attract a discount.
Oilfast reserves the right to amend the scheme without notice and to disallow discounts where not appropriate.
The voucher is redeemable only on your next Oilfast purchase — it offsets planned spending, not cash.
